The Life and Times of Extreme Cage Fighter Mark Kerr

If your nature is fire, it is the law, you will burn

Sandahl Bergman tempted Conan and now she is ready to take on the world!

Get ready to rock n' rüle!

Bomb it, but don't blow it!

High Sheriff for the Council of State

You are going to commit another murder...

YOU'VE HEARD ABOUT IT! READ ABOUT IT! NOW *SEE* THE WORLD'S GREATEST ENTERTAINMENT HIT!

Ten years ago something terrible happened in this house... This weekend it's about to happen AGAIN.

Robert Mitchum is the hunted... Europe is the hunting ground!

What's your idea of justice... have you ever thought about it?

A cry in the night... A gasp in the dark...

Will you choose to be what you had no choice in being...

Mystery... chills... an ending that you'll never guess!

What was the truth about Ada?
